about_short_description.short_description: Anjuna enables organizations to securely embrace the cloud by leveraging confidential computing technologies without changing applications.

product.name: Anjuna Seaglass
product.description: A confidential computing platform that creates secure enclaves to isolate and protect data, code, and secrets across multiple public clouds without requiring code changes.

product.name: Anjuna Northstar
product.description: A platform that enables secure data fusion and collaboration by merging proprietary data and AI models with partner data while protecting intellectual property.

product.name: Anjuna AI Clean Rooms
product.description: A secure environment that enables multiple parties to collaboratively train AI models or analyze data without exposing each party’s sensitive information.

product.name: Anjuna Policy Manager
product.description: A tool that securely stores and distributes application secrets using attestation to reduce the risk of secret exposure.

product.name: Anjuna Overwatch
product.description: Anjuna Overwatch is a confidential computing–protected control plane that governs autonomous AI agents’ behavior, data access, compliance, and cost.

product.name: Anjuna Seaglass on AMD SEV
product.description: A confidential computing platform deployment that protects containerized workloads on AMD SEV-powered bare-metal and on-premises data-center infrastructure.
